description:
SYSTEMS THINKING is my first ever album. I've been working on it since August 2024, on and off, some months more than others. I like to call it a project as there's more going on than just the music. the artwork, visuals(that are to follow) and even this website are also important to me as it all comes together to craft SYSTEMS THINKING, with the album kinda just being the entry point and default experience. 

 this project takes a few pages out of my life exploring my thoughts, feelings and experiences over the last few years. And does so via embedding these things into a story called SYSTEMS THINKING. I could say much more about this album but that's all you need to know before going in!

 I wanted to craft a bespoke experience with this project thus sponsored and produced this project myself, under my own label OMOcloud. with in-house contributions from...

Shin:
Art, GFX, 3d, CSS dev

SYSTEMS THINKING is available everywhere. 

give it a listen and lmk what you think! 

-SAI
